simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to מָצוֹר (H4693) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-pr-loc.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 4 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
simple.summary: מָצוֹר (mâtsôwr) means Egypt (as the border of Palestine) First listed occurrence: 2Kgs 19 24.

definitions.full: H4693. Matsor מָצוֺר proper name, of a territory = מִצְרַיִם ; only in poetry: מ ׳יֶאֹרֵי Isa 19:6 ; 2Kin 19:24 = Isa 37:25 ; מ וְעָרֵי ׳אַשּׁוּד מ ׳וּלְמִנִּי נָהָר וְעַד לְמִנִּי יָבוֺא וְעָדֶיךָ Micah 7:12 ( ᵐ5 misunderstands everywhere).
definitions.rootNote: the same as 4692 in the sense of a limit ;
